title: FA Adjustable Dumbbell - 40 kg
description:
Cageless, fastest adjusting, and built to be dropped. 2.5 kg steps from 5 kg up to 40 or 55 kg. Sold as a pair with cradles.

The cradle is what changes the weight, in 2.5 kg increments. You can add plates later, so starting with the 40 kg does not lock you out of the 55.

  • Two models: 5-40 kg or 5-55 kg each.
  • Sold as a pair, cradles included.
  • Cageless design.
  • Lifetime warranty, and accidental drops up to 1 m are covered.
  • Plates: cast iron, sandy black powder coat, 190 mm diameter.
  • Handle: chromed carbon steel, 35 mm diameter, 118 mm grip length.
  • Dumbbell length: 466 / 545 mm (40 / 55 kg).
  • Cradle: 558 mm long, 212 mm wide.
  • The Dumbbell Cart is an optional add-on with 3 rack heights, and rolls on casters.
